title: A Place of Worship, Refuge, and Outreach
speaker: Pastor Mike Roth
description: Pastor Mike Roth delivered an inspiring sermon titled "A Place of Worship, Refuge, and Outreach," reminding us of the core mission that drives our congregation. Reflecting on Psalm 27, we explored the profound message of trusting in the Lord as our light and salvation, and the importance of our mission statement in guiding us through life's challenges.
